- Using `callr::rscript` to create a clean and empty runtime for a R script. This is especially useful when `source` an external R script/file within a running R session.

- Using `here::here` for better file path management. This is especially useful if you want to share your project/code with others. It will save others time for setting up a working direcotory.

- Using `ALT + 0` to fold codes, and `ALT + SHIFT + 0` to reverse.
